items.quote: the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel
items.claim: A person of mixed Israelite-Egyptian heritage went out among the children of Israel
items.actor: the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian

items.quote: this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp
items.claim: The Israelite-Egyptian son and an Israelite man fought together in the camp
items.actor: the son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel

items.quote: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed
items.claim: The Israelite woman's son blasphemed God's name and cursed
items.action: blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed

items.quote: And they brought him unto Moses
items.claim: Unspecified persons brought the son to Moses

items.quote: his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan
items.claim: Shelomith daughter of Dibri of the tribe of Dan was the son's mother

items.quote: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them
items.claim: Unspecified persons confined him in order to receive divine guidance
items.mechanism: that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them
